Hiring: Senior Full Stack Engineer – React/Vue.js & Python(Contract)
📍 Location: Hartford, CT(Onsite)
💼 Experience: 10+ Years
Looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer with expertise in:
🔹 React, Vue.js, JavaScript & TypeScript
🔹 Python, FastAPI/Flask & REST APIs
🔹 Redux, HTML5 & CSS3
🔹 SQL/MySQL & Data Platforms
🔹 Docker, CI/CD & Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)
🔹 Authentication & Authorization
🔹 Data Visualization & API Integration

If you're exploring new opportunities or know someone who may be a great fit, DM me or share your resume to guru.prasanth@vrproit.com!
